title: CRTFE-HCM v1.1.0: Dorian Phase Relation Reproducibility and Transferability Release
description: Versioned reproducibility archive for the CRTFE-HCM Stage 1A carrier-level transferability result and current near-luminal mathematical analysis. The tagged GitHub release contains the exact 48-C/48-L topology, frozen numerical environment, fixed-K protocol and held-out split, harmonic-balance/reproduction/verification code, complete complex h=-15..15 reference sideband output, expected outputs and controls, the known-invalid fixed-f_m/varying-K path, and a one-command reproduction workflow. The GitHub release archive SHA-256 is 3721dc604f12a3ac5818a0c39c031a0d2439cb6083bde604158a475a00a8d86b. The frozen Stage 1A carrier-level acceptance gates reproduce; full-sideband reduced-effective-model transferability remains open. Numerical/theoretical only; no experimental hardware-performance claim.
